reviews.text: AVOID AT ALL COSTS. (They keep deleting this review BTW, 3RD TIME POSTING). This vetinary practice is the reason my dog died last year, my biggest regret is that I brought him here. It was a simple anal glad removal, however we got a butcher of a vet and he could never go to the toilet again properly. 6 months later he died. Whenever we mentioned it to them, they would come out with all the BS. Saying it'll go back to normal etc...it never did and my boy died 6 months later. The vet who performed the operation, haven't seen him since. Clearly hushed and covered up. 2k for an operation and they did it all wrong. They'll take your money but not any responsibility. If you care for your pets, take them somewhere else cause they end up dead here

I took my father's senior cat into the Veterinary Clinic in January 2025 because he had a chronic skin problem.

An appointment was booked for later that day. After a short wait (due to the vet operating on another pet) I explained the symptoms & the cat was examined. Immediately, the vet identified the issue & explained how it could be remedied.

Within 2 weeks we could see a marked improvement & I continued to administer the medication for a further 2 months. The cat now looks great & is in good health again.

I would highly recommend the Veterinary Clinic. The staff are friendly, professional  & clearly have the expertise, which is very much needed especially when a pet is ill. A well-deserved 5 stars. Thank you✨️

Bit of a late review - better late than never.
I left this veterinary practice really upset. Took my senior cat in for a check up around April/May 2024 due to her not being well. I found the vet I saw to be quite cold and judgemental. My cat was 17 years at the time and had become frail and thin. This was pointed out and left me feeling as though I'd been starving and mistreating my cat. My cat was adminstered meds which helped however, the entire explanation and process of this was not explained. I left with a whopping bill. Safe to say that I will not be using this practice again when registering other pets.

My dodgy had two lumps that needed removing. The pre, post surgery was excellent. Explained everything, went through options, were clear on costs and aftercare needed. All appointments were pre booked and compassion was given for this worried dog mom. Thanks to all at Great Barr surgery.
